en.advice_home_failed: Check the arm pose and gripper by hand, rerun with a new run id once safe
en.advice_judgement_unproven: Read the notes; check the judging service
en.advice_policy_error: Check the policy server is up and matches the plan
en.advice_recorder_failed: Check disk space and directory permissions, read the notes
en.advice_recovery_ambiguous: Check the arm state and the log by hand
en.advice_safety_stop: Check the arm and the health monitor on site, rerun with a new run id
en.advice_watchdog_timeout: Read the exception text in the notes; check the policy, camera and robot services are up
en.confirm_resume: This wait needs a second confirmation: press y if you have handled it and want to resume (Enter does not count); n cancels, q ends
en.console_close_failed: Console close failed (the run result is unchanged): {why}
en.fault_advice: Advice: {advice}. A locked run cannot be resumed; start again with a new run id.
en.fault_ctrl_c: This lock was caused by Ctrl+C: motion was refused and the arm is held; check the arm pose on site before rerunning.
en.fault_judgement_unproven: The judgement could not be proven
en.fault_recovery_ambiguous: The outcome of an action is unknown after an interrupted run
en.fault_unknown_advice: Read the notes and the log, then handle it by hand
en.health_warning: Warning: the health monitor is not green; resuming or releasing motion will be refused.
en.interrupt: Received {name} (Ctrl+C): motion commands stopped, finishing safely; no new round will start.
en.round_end_hidden: ── Round {n}/{total} ended; recorded (this terminal does not show the automatic verdict) ──
en.round_end_hidden_labels: ── Round {n}/{total} ended; recorded, the automatic verdict shows after your label ──
en.run_cancelled: Cancelled before connecting to the robot.
en.run_confirm_warning: This connects to the robot and may move it. Confirm the reviewed scene, limits, checkpoints, active providers and hardware readiness.
en.st_event_pause: Event trigger: policy paused, the vision model is judging
en.st_reset_policy: The reset policy is resetting the environment
en.sub_forward_hint: Subtask running: s marks the round a success, f a failure (both end the forward loop; the reverse loop still restores), d discards the round (restored, then replaced)
en.sub_inv_no: List rejected: the run waits for a person
en.sub_inv_title: Objects the VLM listed (once confirmed, this is the run's whitelist):
en.sub_inv_todo: Press y if the list is right, n if not (the run waits for a person); q ends the run
en.sub_inv_yes: List confirmed and frozen as the whitelist
en.sub_release: Round {n}/{total}: when the scene is ready press Enter to release this round's forward subtask loop; q ends the run
en.sub_reverse_ignored: The reverse loop is restoring the scene: this key does nothing here (stop still works: Ctrl+C)
en.sub_wait_after_forward: stopped after the forward loop of round {n}; the reverse reset did not run: restore the scene by hand before Enter (q if unsure)
en.sub_wait_forward: stopped during the forward loop of round {n}; the reverse reset did not run: restore the scene by hand before Enter (q if unsure)
en.sub_wait_idle: no subtask of this round has moved: the scene is as it was
en.sub_wait_reverse: stopped during the reverse loop of round {n}; the scene is only partly restored: restore it by hand before Enter (q if unsure)
en.sum_mode_human: Mode: no reset policy (a person resets the environment)
en.sum_mode_policy: Mode: with reset policy (the reset policy resets)
en.sum_mode_subtask: Mode: subtask loop (no reset policy: the VLM plans subtasks, the evaluation policy runs them, a reverse loop restores the scene)
en.sum_ops_human: Each round: reset the environment and press [Enter], then answer the scene question with y/n/u
en.sum_ops_subtask: Each round: confirm the object list (once, at the start), press Enter to release each round; s/f/d during the forward loop label the round
en.sum_outcome_auto: automatic, by event intelligence and the vision model (may stop early, mode {mode})
en.sum_outcome_budget: no early stop (all steps run); success comes from labels or post-hoc judging
en.sum_pose: Start pose check: done by preflight after you confirm; if it fails the run waits and says why (not shown here)
en.sum_rounds: Rounds: {episodes}; at most {max_steps} forward steps each
en.sum_scene_operator: the operator, by key at this terminal (the page can answer too)
en.sum_scene_provider: a machine provider first (for reference only); each round is released by the operator typing y/n/u at this terminal
en.sum_stop: Stop any time: Ctrl+C, or q at a prompt
en.svc_gpu: {n}/{total} Free GPU memory {free} MiB, needed {need} MiB (policy {policy} + VLM {vlm})
en.svc_inventory: {n}/{total} Object list: y confirms, n rejects / stop: q or Ctrl+C
en.svc_leftover_stopped: {n}/{total} Our unit {unit} left by an earlier run: identity checked, stopped
en.svc_not_released: {n}/{total} Release not confirmed: stopped {stopped}; our pids still on the GPU {left}; in use {used} MiB ({baseline} MiB before). Check by hand
en.svc_not_stopped: Unit {unit} was not stopped ({why}): it is not stopped when its identity does not match; a person decides
en.svc_policy_ready: {n}/{total} Policy service ready, GPU memory in use {used} MiB
en.svc_port_held: {n}/{total} Port {port} is held by something that is not this run's unit: nothing is started and it is not stopped. Stop the live service (levi live stop) and start again
en.svc_preflight: {n}/{total} Preflight: GPU lock, GPU memory, host memory, ports / nothing to do / stop: Ctrl+C
en.svc_released: {n}/{total} Stopped {stopped}; our processes left the GPU (in use {used} MiB, {baseline} MiB before)
en.svc_rounds: {n}/{total} Rounds: press Enter to release each round / stop: Ctrl+C
en.svc_shutdown: {n}/{total} Shutdown: stopping the VLM and the policy, checking the GPU memory came back / wait
en.svc_stopped: Our units stopped: {units}; nothing else was touched
en.svc_vlm_ready: {n}/{total} VLM ready: unit {unit}, pid {pid}, GPU memory {mib} MiB
en.svc_vlm_sleep: {n}/{total} Putting the VLM to sleep (MemAvailable checked first) / wait / stop: Ctrl+C
en.svc_vlm_start: {n}/{total} Starting the VLM service (our unit) and waiting until it is ready; the first start may take minutes / wait / stop: Ctrl+C
en.swap_unclean_head: Earlier policy switches did not end cleanly; their service state is not assumed. Before confirming, check each unit (systemctl --user status <unit>), the policy ports (ss -ltnp), nvidia-smi and that the arm is at its home pose:
en.todo_check_resume: Fix the fault and check the health monitor is green, then press [Enter] to resume (q ends)
en.todo_home_pose_resume: Home the arm by hand as setup.md says (gripper open), then press [Enter], then y to confirm; the resume checks again (q ends)
en.todo_home_resume: The resume checks automatically that the arm is home and does not resume otherwise. Home the arm by hand as setup.md says, then press [Enter], then y to confirm (q ends)
en.todo_judge_resume: Check the judging service, then press [Enter] to resume (then y to confirm; q ends)
en.todo_other_resume: Handle it, then press [Enter] to resume (q ends)
en.todo_policy_resume: Check the policy server is up, then press [Enter] to resume (then y to confirm; q ends)
en.todo_reset_enter: Reset the environment, then press [Enter] (q ends)
en.todo_reset_resume: Reset the environment, then press [Enter] to resume (q ends)
en.todo_stop_resume: Press [Enter] to resume after checking (then y to confirm), or q to end
en.todo_subtask_inventory: Check the cameras and the table, then press [Enter]: the VLM lists the objects again (q ends)
en.todo_subtask_release: Press [Enter] to be asked again whether to release the round (q ends)
en.todo_subtask_replan: Check the scene and the VLM, then press [Enter]: a new round is released and planned again (q ends)
en.todo_subtask_restart: Put the scene back as it was at the round's start, then press [Enter]: the round starts again (q ends)
en.todo_subtask_restart_confirm: Put the scene back as it was at the round's start, then press [Enter], then y to confirm: the round starts again (q ends)
en.todo_vlm_resume: Free GPU or host memory, check the VLM service, then press [Enter], then y to confirm (q ends)
en.verdict_hint: While this round runs: s ends it as a success, f as a failure, d discards it (other keys do nothing)
en.verdict_taken: Your verdict: {verdict}; this round ends early, the next one follows after the home
en.wait_contract_violation_limit: The judge broke its contract repeatedly
en.wait_home_not_executed: Home was refused before its first command: the arm did not go home and stands where the last episode ended
en.wait_home_pose_not_reached: The arm is not at the home pose (the error is in start_pose_checked below); not resumed
en.wait_policy_error: The policy is unavailable or failed
en.wait_preflight_failed: Preflight failed (health monitor or robot state)
en.wait_reset_horizon_exhausted: The reset policy used all its steps without resetting
en.wait_scene_unknown: The scene cannot be judged (cannot see / not enough evidence)
en.wait_subtask_check_unavailable: The VLM could not tell whether {loop} subtask #{index} is done (null, unreadable or no answer)
en.wait_subtask_not_released: This round was not released at terminal D
en.wait_subtask_plan_refused: The VLM's {loop} plan was refused ({reason}); nothing moved
en.wait_subtask_retry_limit: {loop} subtask #{index} failed its check {attempt} times (retry limit {limit})
en.wait_vlm_sleep_refused: The VLM was not put to sleep ({reason}; MemAvailable {mem} GiB, needed {need}); the policy did not start
en.wait_vlm_unavailable: The VLM could not be woken or put to sleep safely; nothing moved
en.wait_vlm_wake_failed: The VLM did not wake up ({reason}); nothing moved
en.wait_vlm_wake_refused: The VLM was not woken: free GPU memory {free} MiB < threshold {threshold} MiB; nothing moved

zh.advice_home_failed: 人工检查机械臂位姿与夹爪，确认安全后再用新的 run id 重跑
zh.advice_judgement_unproven: 查看 notes；检查判定服务
zh.advice_policy_error: 确认策略服务在线并与计划一致
zh.advice_recorder_failed: 检查磁盘空间与目录权限，查看 notes
zh.advice_recovery_ambiguous: 人工检查机械臂状态与日志
zh.advice_safety_stop: 现场确认机械臂与健康监控，用新的 run id 重跑
zh.advice_watchdog_timeout: 看 notes 里的异常文本；确认策略/相机/机器人服务在线
zh.confirm_resume: 这类等待需二次确认：确认已处理好并要续跑，请按 y（Enter 无效）；按 n 取消，q 结束
zh.console_close_failed: 控制台关闭失败（运行结果不受影响）：{why}
zh.fault_advice: 建议：{advice}。已锁定的运行不能续跑，需用新的 run id 重新开始。
zh.fault_ctrl_c: 此锁定由 Ctrl+C 触发：运动指令被拒绝并已保持机械臂；请现场确认机械臂位姿后再重跑。
zh.fault_recovery_ambiguous: 上次运行中断后无法确认动作结果
zh.fault_unknown_advice: 查看 notes 与日志后人工处理
zh.fault_watchdog_timeout: 看门狗超时或编排器异常
zh.health_red: 健康检查未通过（{why}），未续跑。
zh.health_warning: 警告：健康监控不是绿色，续跑/放行会被拒绝。
zh.interrupt: 收到 {name}（Ctrl+C）：已停止下发运动指令，正在安全收尾，不会再开始新的一轮。
zh.round_end_hidden: ── 第 {n}/{total} 轮 结束；结果已记录（本终端不显示自动判定）──
zh.round_end_hidden_labels: ── 第 {n}/{total} 轮 结束；结果已记录，标注后显示自动判定 ──
zh.round_end_shown: ── 第 {n}/{total} 轮 结束  步数 {steps}/{max_steps}；结束方式 {ended} ──
zh.run_cancelled: 已在连接机器人之前取消。
zh.run_confirm_warning: 这将连接机器人并可能让它运动。请确认已核对的场景、限位、检查点、生效的提供方和硬件就绪情况。
zh.run_stopped_by_signal: 已被信号 {signum} 停止；最终状态 {state}。
zh.st_event_pause: 事件触发，策略已暂停，视觉模型判定中
zh.st_reset_policy: reset 策略正在复位环境
zh.st_stopped: 已按停止请求结束：完成 {done}/{total} 轮
zh.sub_forward_hint: 子任务进行中：s 记本轮成功、f 记失败（都结束正向循环，逆向循环照常复位），d 作废本轮（复位后重做一轮）
zh.sub_inv_no: 清单被否决：运行等待人工处理
zh.sub_inv_title: VLM 列出的物体（这一份确认后就是本次运行的白名单）：
zh.sub_inv_todo: 清单对就按 y 确认，不对按 n（运行转人工等待）；q 结束运行
zh.sub_inv_yes: 清单已确认，冻结为白名单
zh.sub_release: 第 {n}/{total} 轮：确认场景就绪后按 Enter 放行本轮正向子任务循环；q 结束运行
zh.sub_reverse_ignored: 逆向循环正在复位场景：这个键在这里不起作用（停止仍然有效：Ctrl+C）
zh.sub_wait_after_forward: 停在第 {n} 轮正向循环结束之后；本轮的逆向复位没有执行：按 Enter 之前请手动恢复场景（拿不准就按 q）
zh.sub_wait_forward: 停在第 {n} 轮的正向循环中；本轮的逆向复位没有执行：按 Enter 之前请手动恢复场景（拿不准就按 q）
zh.sub_wait_idle: 这一轮还没有任何子任务动过：场景保持原样
zh.sub_wait_reverse: 停在第 {n} 轮的逆向循环中；场景只复位了一部分：按 Enter 之前请手动恢复场景（拿不准就按 q）
zh.sum_judge: 判定来源：场景核对 = {scene}；成败 = {outcome}
zh.sum_mode_human: 模式：不含复位策略（人工复位环境）
zh.sum_mode_policy: 模式：含复位策略（reset policy 复位）
zh.sum_mode_subtask: 模式：子任务循环（无复位策略：VLM 规划子任务，测评策略执行，逆向循环复位）
zh.sum_ops_human: 每轮操作：复位环境后按 [Enter]，再按 y/n/u 回答场景题
zh.sum_ops_subtask: 每轮操作：确认物体清单（只在开始时一次），每轮按 Enter 放行；正向循环中 s/f/d 给本轮下判定
zh.sum_outcome_auto: 事件智能/视觉模型自动判定（可提前结束，模式 {mode}）
zh.sum_outcome_budget: 不提前结束（跑满步数），成败由标签/事后判定
zh.sum_pose: 起始位姿检查：确认后由预检执行；未通过时进入等待并说明原因（本屏无结果）
zh.sum_rounds: 轮次：{episodes} 轮；每轮 forward 最多 {max_steps} 步
zh.sum_scene_operator: 操作员在本终端按键（页面也可答）
zh.sum_scene_provider: 机器 provider 先判断（仅供参考），每轮由操作员在本终端键入 y/n/u 放行
zh.sum_stop: 随时停止：Ctrl+C，或在提示处按 q
zh.svc_gpu: {n}/{total} 空闲显存 {free} MiB，需要 {need} MiB（策略 {policy} + VLM {vlm}）
zh.svc_inventory: {n}/{total} 物体清单：按 y 确认、n 否决 / 停止：q 或 Ctrl+C
zh.svc_leftover_stopped: {n}/{total} 上次运行留下的本方单元 {unit} 已核对身份并停止
zh.svc_not_released: {n}/{total} 没能确认释放：已停止 {stopped}；仍在 GPU 上的本方 pid {left}；显存 {used} MiB（开始前 {baseline} MiB）。请人工核对
zh.svc_not_stopped: 单元 {unit} 没有停止（{why}）：身份对不上时不停止，请人工处理
zh.svc_policy_ready: {n}/{total} 策略服务就绪，显存合计 {used} MiB
zh.svc_port_held: {n}/{total} 端口 {port} 已被占用且不是本次运行的单元：不启动，也不停止它。请先停止实时服务（levi live stop）再重来
zh.svc_preflight: {n}/{total} 预检：GPU 锁、显存、内存、端口 / 无需操作 / 停止：Ctrl+C
zh.svc_released: {n}/{total} 已停止 {stopped}；本方进程已离开 GPU（显存 {used} MiB，开始前 {baseline} MiB）
zh.svc_rounds: {n}/{total} 各轮：每轮按 Enter 放行 / 停止：Ctrl+C
zh.svc_shutdown: {n}/{total} 收尾：停止 VLM、停止策略、核对显存释放 / 等待
zh.svc_stopped: 已停止的本方单元：{units}；其他进程一概未动
zh.svc_vlm_ready: {n}/{total} VLM 就绪：单元 {unit}，pid {pid}，显存 {mib} MiB
zh.svc_vlm_sleep: {n}/{total} 让 VLM 睡眠（先查 MemAvailable）/ 等待 / 停止：Ctrl+C
zh.svc_vlm_start: {n}/{total} 启动 VLM 服务（本方单元），等待就绪，首次可能要几分钟 / 等待 / 停止：Ctrl+C
zh.swap_unclean_head: 之前的策略切换没有干净结束，不假定其服务状态。确认前请逐个检查服务单元（systemctl --user status <unit>）、策略端口（ss -ltnp）、nvidia-smi，并确认机械臂在回位姿态：
zh.todo_check_resume: 请先排除故障、确认健康监控为绿，再按 [Enter] 续跑（q 结束）
zh.todo_home_pose_resume: 请按 setup.md 手动回 Home（夹爪张开），然后按 [Enter]，再按 y 确认；续跑前会再检查一次（q 结束）
zh.todo_home_resume: 续跑前会自动检查是否在 Home；不在则不续跑。请先按 setup.md 手动回 Home，然后按 [Enter]，再按 y 确认（q 结束）
zh.todo_judge_resume: 请检查判定服务，再按 [Enter] 续跑（随后需按 y 确认；q 结束）
zh.todo_other_resume: 请处理后按 [Enter] 续跑（q 结束）
zh.todo_policy_resume: 请确认策略服务在线，再按 [Enter] 续跑（随后需按 y 确认；q 结束）
zh.todo_reset_enter: 请复位环境，完成后按 [Enter]（q 结束）
zh.todo_reset_resume: 请复位环境，完成后按 [Enter] 续跑（q 结束）
zh.todo_stop_resume: 确认后按 [Enter] 续跑（随后需按 y 确认），或按 q 结束
zh.todo_subtask_inventory: 检查相机和桌面后按 [Enter]：VLM 重新列物体清单（q 结束）
zh.todo_subtask_release: 按 [Enter] 后会再问一次是否放行（q 结束）
zh.todo_subtask_replan: 检查场景和 VLM 后按 [Enter]：重新放行一轮并重新规划（q 结束）
zh.todo_subtask_restart: 把场景摆回一轮开始时的样子，再按 [Enter]：这一轮从头开始（q 结束）
zh.todo_subtask_restart_confirm: 把场景摆回一轮开始时的样子，再按 [Enter]，随后按 y 确认：这一轮从头开始（q 结束）
zh.todo_vlm_resume: 释放显存或内存、检查 VLM 服务后按 [Enter]，随后按 y 确认（q 结束）
zh.verdict_hint: 本轮进行中：按 s 记成功、f 记失败、d 作废，提前结束本轮（其他键无效）
zh.verdict_taken: 已收到人工判定：{verdict}；本轮提前结束，回位后继续下一轮
zh.wait_home_not_executed: Home 在发出首条命令前被拒：机械臂没有回 Home，仍停在上一片段结束的位置
zh.wait_home_pose_not_reached: 机械臂不在 Home 位姿（误差见下方 start_pose_checked），未续跑
zh.wait_preflight_failed: 预检失败（健康监控或机器人状态）
zh.wait_reset_horizon_exhausted: reset 策略跑满步数仍未复位
zh.wait_scene_unknown: 无法判断场景（看不清/证据不足）
zh.wait_subtask_check_unavailable: VLM 判断不了 {loop} 子任务 #{index} 是否完成（null、看不清或没有回答）
zh.wait_subtask_not_released: 本轮没有在终端 D 放行
zh.wait_subtask_plan_refused: VLM 的 {loop} 计划被拒（{reason}），没有任何动作
zh.wait_subtask_retry_limit: {loop} 子任务 #{index} 判定未完成已达 {attempt} 次（重发上限 {limit}）
zh.wait_vlm_sleep_refused: VLM 没有睡眠（{reason}；MemAvailable {mem} GiB，需要 {need}），策略没有启动
zh.wait_vlm_unavailable: 无法安全地唤醒或让 VLM 睡眠，没有任何动作
zh.wait_vlm_wake_failed: VLM 没有醒来（{reason}），没有任何动作
zh.wait_vlm_wake_refused: VLM 没有唤醒：空闲显存 {free} MiB < 阈值 {threshold} MiB，没有任何动作

en.advice_home_failed: Check the arm pose and gripper by hand, rerun with a new run id once safe
en.advice_judgement_unproven: Read the notes; check the judging service
en.advice_policy_error: Check the policy server is up and matches the plan
en.advice_recorder_failed: Check disk space and directory permissions, read the notes
en.advice_recovery_ambiguous: Check the arm state and the log by hand
en.advice_safety_stop: Check the arm and the health monitor on site, rerun with a new run id
en.advice_watchdog_timeout: Read the exception text in the notes; check the policy, camera and robot services are up
en.confirm_resume: This wait needs a second confirmation: press y if you have handled it and want to resume (Enter does not count); n cancels, q ends
en.console_close_failed: Console close failed (the run result is unchanged): {why}
en.fault_advice: Advice: {advice}. A locked run cannot be resumed; start again with a new run id.
en.fault_ctrl_c: This lock was caused by Ctrl+C: motion was refused and the arm is held; check the arm pose on site before rerunning.
en.fault_judgement_unproven: The judgement could not be proven

en.sub_inv_title: Objects the VLM listed (once confirmed, this is the run's whitelist):

en.svc_shutdown: {n}/{total} Shutdown: stopping the VLM and the policy, checking the GPU memory came back / wait

en.todo_check_resume: Fix the fault and check the health monitor is green, then press [Enter] to resume (q ends)
en.todo_home_pose_resume: Home the arm by hand as setup.md says (gripper open), then press [Enter], then y to confirm; the resume checks again (q ends)

en.todo_other_resume: Handle it, then press [Enter] to resume (q ends)
en.todo_policy_resume: Check the policy server is up, then press [Enter] to resume (then y to confirm; q ends)
en.todo_reset_enter: Reset the environment, then press [Enter] (q ends)
en.todo_reset_resume: Reset the environment, then press [Enter] to resume (q ends)
en.todo_startup_new_run: End this run, inspect and handle the situation manually, then create a new run with fresh confirmation. No automatic fault clearing or homing
en.todo_stop_resume: Press [Enter] to resume after checking (then y to confirm), or q to end

en.todo_subtask_release: Press [Enter] to be asked again whether to release the round (q ends)
en.todo_subtask_replan: Check the scene and the VLM, then press [Enter]: a new round is released and planned again (q ends)

en.todo_subtask_restart_confirm: Put the scene back as it was at the round's start, then press [Enter], then y to confirm: the round starts again (q ends)
en.todo_vlm_resume: Free GPU or host memory, check the VLM service, then press [Enter], then y to confirm (q ends)

zh.wait_vlm_unavailable: 无法安全地唤醒或让 VLM 睡眠，没有任何动作

code.source: self.keys.flush()  # a stale Enter must not release a round

en.advice_home_failed: Check the arm pose and gripper by hand, rerun with a new run id once safe
en.advice_judgement_unproven: Read the notes; check the judging service
en.advice_policy_error: Check the policy server is up and matches the plan
en.advice_recorder_failed: Check disk space and directory permissions, read the notes
en.advice_recovery_ambiguous: Check the arm state and the log by hand
en.advice_safety_stop: Check the arm and the health monitor on site, rerun with a new run id
en.advice_watchdog_timeout: Read the exception text in the notes; check the policy, camera and robot services are up
en.confirm_resume: This wait needs a second confirmation: press y if you have handled it and want to resume (Enter does not count); n cancels, q ends
en.console_close_failed: Console close failed (the run result is unchanged): {why}
en.fault_advice: Advice: {advice}. A locked run cannot be resumed; start again with a new run id.
en.fault_ctrl_c: This lock was caused by Ctrl+C: motion was refused and the arm is held; check the arm pose on site before rerunning.
en.fault_judgement_unproven: The judgement could not be proven
en.fault_recovery_ambiguous: The outcome of an action is unknown after an interrupted run
en.fault_unknown_advice: Read the notes and the log, then handle it by hand
en.health_warning: Warning: the health monitor is not green; resuming or releasing motion will be refused.
en.interrupt: Received {name} (Ctrl+C): motion commands stopped, finishing safely; no new round will start.
en.round_end_hidden: ── Round {n}/{total} ended; recorded (this terminal does not show the automatic verdict) ──
en.round_end_hidden_labels: ── Round {n}/{total} ended; recorded, the automatic verdict shows after your label ──
en.run_cancelled: Cancelled before connecting to the robot.
en.run_confirm_warning: This connects to the robot and may move it. Confirm the reviewed scene, limits, checkpoints, active providers and hardware readiness.
en.st_event_pause: Event trigger: policy paused, the vision model is judging
en.st_reset_policy: The reset policy is resetting the environment
en.startup_home_gripper_will_open: Knowing the gripper will open, authorize this home with h; q cancels. A separate Enter is still required to release the round afterwards.
en.startup_home_object_handled: Startup homing opens the gripper. Safely handle any held object, then press o; q cancels. Enter does not authorize homing.
en.startup_home_path_clear: Check the entire return path to Home is clear, then press p; q cancels.
en.sub_forward_hint: Subtask running: s marks the round a success, f a failure (both end the forward loop; the reverse loop still restores), d discards the round (restored, then replaced)
en.sub_inv_no: List rejected: the run waits for a person
en.sub_inv_title: Objects the VLM listed (once confirmed, this is the run's whitelist):
en.sub_inv_todo: Press y if the list is right, n if not (the run waits for a person); q ends the run
en.sub_inv_yes: List confirmed and frozen as the whitelist
en.sub_release: Round {n}/{total}: when the scene is ready press Enter to release this round's forward subtask loop; q ends the run
en.sub_reverse_hint: Reverse reset: m requests a stop for human reset (not an emergency stop). An admitted step may contain multiple commands; wait for safe stopping. Acceptance does not mean it is safe to approach.
en.sub_reverse_ignored: The reverse loop is restoring the scene: this key does nothing here (stop still works: Ctrl+C)
en.sub_reverse_requested: Human reset requested: waiting for policy quiescence, recording seal and any home allowed by the existing configuration. This message does not authorize approaching the arm; a fault requires resolution first.
en.sub_wait_after_forward: stopped after the forward loop of round {n}; the reverse reset did not run: restore the scene by hand before Enter (q if unsure)
en.sub_wait_forward: stopped during the forward loop of round {n}; the reverse reset did not run: restore the scene by hand before Enter (q if unsure)
en.sub_wait_idle: no subtask of this round has moved: the scene is as it was
en.sub_wait_reverse: stopped during the reverse loop of round {n}; the scene is only partly restored: restore it by hand before Enter (q if unsure)
en.subtask_early_shown: ── Current forward subtask paused at step {step}/{max_steps} ({trigger}): held and saved, the VLM checks whether it is done; if not, it runs on for the remaining steps ──
en.subtask_end_shown: ── Current forward subtask ended  steps {steps}/{max_steps}; ended by {ended} ──
en.sum_early_check: Early checks: on an event ({events}) or every {every} steps, the running subtask is held and saved and the VLM checks whether it is done; done goes to the next subtask, not done runs on for the remaining steps (at most {max_checks} per attempt)
en.sum_mode_human: Mode: no reset policy (a person resets the environment)
en.sum_mode_policy: Mode: with reset policy (the reset policy resets)
en.sum_mode_subtask: Mode: subtask loop (no reset policy: the VLM plans subtasks, the evaluation policy runs them, a reverse loop restores the scene)
en.sum_ops_human: Each round: reset the environment and press [Enter], then answer the scene question with y/n/u
en.sum_ops_subtask: Each round: confirm the object list (once, at the start), press Enter to release each round; s/f/d during the forward loop label the round
en.sum_outcome_auto: automatic, by event intelligence and the vision model (may stop early, mode {mode})
en.sum_outcome_budget: no early stop (all steps run); success comes from labels or post-hoc judging
en.sum_pose: Start pose check: done by preflight after you confirm; if it fails the run waits and says why (not shown here)
en.sum_rounds: Rounds: {episodes}; at most {max_steps} forward steps each
en.sum_rounds_subtask: Rounds: {episodes}; at most {max_steps} steps per forward or reverse subtask
en.sum_scene_operator: the operator, by key at this terminal (the page can answer too)
en.sum_scene_provider: a machine provider first (for reference only); each round is released by the operator typing y/n/u at this terminal
en.sum_stop: Stop any time: Ctrl+C, or q at a prompt
en.svc_gpu: {n}/{total} Free GPU memory {free} MiB, needed {need} MiB (policy {policy} + VLM {vlm})
en.svc_inventory: {n}/{total} Object list: y confirms, n rejects / stop: q or Ctrl+C
en.svc_leftover_stopped: {n}/{total} Our unit {unit} left by an earlier run: identity checked, stopped
en.svc_not_released: {n}/{total} Release not confirmed: stopped {stopped}; our pids still on the GPU {left}; in use {used} MiB ({baseline} MiB before). Check by hand
en.svc_not_stopped: Unit {unit} was not stopped ({why}): it is not stopped when its identity does not match; a person decides
en.svc_policy_ready: {n}/{total} Policy service ready, GPU memory in use {used} MiB
en.svc_port_held: {n}/{total} Port {port} is held by something that is not this run's unit: nothing is started and it is not stopped. Stop the live service (levi live stop) and start again
en.svc_preflight: {n}/{total} Preflight: GPU lock, GPU memory, host memory, ports / nothing to do / stop: Ctrl+C
en.svc_released: {n}/{total} Stopped {stopped}; our processes left the GPU (in use {used} MiB, {baseline} MiB before)
en.svc_rounds: {n}/{total} Rounds: press Enter to release each round / stop: Ctrl+C
en.svc_shutdown: {n}/{total} Shutdown: stopping the VLM and the policy, checking the GPU memory came back / wait
en.svc_stopped: Our units stopped: {units}; nothing else was touched
en.svc_vlm_ready: {n}/{total} VLM ready: unit {unit}, pid {pid}, GPU memory {mib} MiB
en.svc_vlm_sleep: {n}/{total} Putting the VLM to sleep (MemAvailable checked first) / wait / stop: Ctrl+C
en.svc_vlm_start: {n}/{total} Starting the VLM service (our unit) and waiting until it is ready; the first start may take minutes / wait / stop: Ctrl+C
en.swap_unclean_head: Earlier policy switches did not end cleanly; their service state is not assumed. Before confirming, check each unit (systemctl --user status <unit>), the policy ports (ss -ltnp), nvidia-smi and that the arm is at its home pose:
en.todo_camera_stale_resume: Check both cameras (USB connection, picture updating), home the arm by hand as setup.md says, then press [Enter], then y to confirm (q ends)
en.todo_check_resume: Fix the fault and check the health monitor is green, then press [Enter] to resume (q ends)
en.todo_home_pose_resume: Home the arm by hand as setup.md says (gripper open), then press [Enter], then y to confirm; the resume checks again (q ends)
en.todo_home_resume: The resume checks automatically that the arm is home and does not resume otherwise. Home the arm by hand as setup.md says, then press [Enter], then y to confirm (q ends)
en.todo_judge_resume: Check the judging service, then press [Enter] to resume (then y to confirm; q ends)
en.todo_other_resume: Handle it, then press [Enter] to resume (q ends)
en.todo_policy_resume: Check the policy server is up, then press [Enter] to resume (then y to confirm; q ends)
en.todo_reset_enter: Reset the environment, then press [Enter] (q ends)
en.todo_reset_resume: Reset the environment, then press [Enter] to resume (q ends)
en.todo_startup_new_run: End this run, inspect and handle the situation manually, then create a new run with fresh confirmation. No automatic fault clearing or homing
en.todo_stop_resume: Press [Enter] to resume after checking (then y to confirm), or q to end
en.todo_subtask_inventory: Check the cameras and the table, then press [Enter]: the VLM lists the objects again (q ends)
en.todo_subtask_release: Press [Enter] to be asked again whether to release the round (q ends)
en.todo_subtask_replan: Check the scene and the VLM, then press [Enter]: a new round is released and planned again (q ends)
en.todo_subtask_restart: Put the scene back as it was at the round's start, then press [Enter]: the round starts again (q ends)
en.todo_subtask_restart_confirm: Put the scene back as it was at the round's start, then press [Enter], then y to confirm: the round starts again (q ends)
en.todo_vlm_resume: Free GPU or host memory, check the VLM service, then press [Enter], then y to confirm (q ends)
en.verdict_hint: While this round runs: s ends it as a success, f as a failure, d discards it (other keys do nothing)
en.verdict_taken: Your verdict: {verdict}; this round ends early, the next one follows after the home
en.wait_camera_stale: The camera frames stopped (the frame number did not change for several steps, or the frame is too old; see camera_stale below): the episode ended, no further action was sent, the arm stands where it stopped and did not go home
en.wait_contract_violation_limit: The judge broke its contract repeatedly
en.wait_home_not_executed: Home was refused before its first command: the arm did not go home and stands where the last episode ended
en.wait_home_pose_not_reached: The arm is not at the home pose (the error is in start_pose_checked below); not resumed
en.wait_policy_error: The policy is unavailable or failed
en.wait_preflight_failed: Preflight failed (health monitor or robot state)
en.wait_reset_horizon_exhausted: The reset policy used all its steps without resetting
en.wait_scene_unknown: The scene cannot be judged (cannot see / not enough evidence)
en.wait_startup_home_not_executed: Startup home sent no motion; admission stays closed and this run cannot retry or resume
en.wait_subtask_check_unavailable: The VLM could not tell whether {loop} subtask #{index} is done (null, unreadable or no answer)
en.wait_subtask_not_released: This round was not released at terminal D
en.wait_subtask_plan_refused: The VLM's {loop} plan was refused ({reason}); nothing moved
en.wait_subtask_retry_limit: {loop} subtask #{index} failed its check {attempt} times (retry limit {limit})
en.wait_vlm_sleep_refused: The VLM was not put to sleep ({reason}; MemAvailable {mem} GiB, needed {need}); the policy did not start
en.wait_vlm_unavailable: The VLM could not be woken or put to sleep safely; nothing moved
en.wait_vlm_wake_failed: The VLM did not wake up ({reason}); nothing moved
en.wait_vlm_wake_refused: The VLM was not woken: free GPU memory {free} MiB < threshold {threshold} MiB; nothing moved

zh.advice_home_failed: 人工检查机械臂位姿与夹爪，确认安全后再用新的 run id 重跑
zh.advice_judgement_unproven: 查看 notes；检查判定服务
zh.advice_policy_error: 确认策略服务在线并与计划一致
zh.advice_recorder_failed: 检查磁盘空间与目录权限，查看 notes
zh.advice_recovery_ambiguous: 人工检查机械臂状态与日志
zh.advice_safety_stop: 现场确认机械臂与健康监控，用新的 run id 重跑
zh.advice_watchdog_timeout: 看 notes 里的异常文本；确认策略/相机/机器人服务在线
zh.confirm_resume: 这类等待需二次确认：确认已处理好并要续跑，请按 y（Enter 无效）；按 n 取消，q 结束
zh.console_close_failed: 控制台关闭失败（运行结果不受影响）：{why}
zh.fault_advice: 建议：{advice}。已锁定的运行不能续跑，需用新的 run id 重新开始。
zh.fault_ctrl_c: 此锁定由 Ctrl+C 触发：运动指令被拒绝并已保持机械臂；请现场确认机械臂位姿后再重跑。
zh.fault_recovery_ambiguous: 上次运行中断后无法确认动作结果
zh.fault_unknown_advice: 查看 notes 与日志后人工处理
zh.fault_watchdog_timeout: 看门狗超时或编排器异常
zh.health_red: 健康检查未通过（{why}），未续跑。
zh.health_warning: 警告：健康监控不是绿色，续跑/放行会被拒绝。
zh.interrupt: 收到 {name}（Ctrl+C）：已停止下发运动指令，正在安全收尾，不会再开始新的一轮。
zh.progress_subtask: 当前正向子任务 步 {steps}/{max_steps}
zh.round_end_hidden: ── 第 {n}/{total} 轮 结束；结果已记录（本终端不显示自动判定）──
zh.round_end_hidden_labels: ── 第 {n}/{total} 轮 结束；结果已记录，标注后显示自动判定 ──
zh.round_end_shown: ── 第 {n}/{total} 轮 结束  步数 {steps}/{max_steps}；结束方式 {ended} ──
zh.run_cancelled: 已在连接机器人之前取消。
zh.run_confirm_warning: 这将连接机器人并可能让它运动。请确认已核对的场景、限位、检查点、生效的提供方和硬件就绪情况。
zh.run_stopped_by_signal: 已被信号 {signum} 停止；最终状态 {state}。
zh.st_event_pause: 事件触发，策略已暂停，视觉模型判定中
zh.st_reset_policy: reset 策略正在复位环境
zh.st_stopped: 已按停止请求结束：完成 {done}/{total} 轮
zh.startup_home_gripper_will_open: 确认知道回位会开爪，并授权本次回位：按 h；q 取消。回位后仍须另按 Enter 放行本轮。
zh.startup_home_object_handled: 首轮回位会打开夹爪。先安全处理夹持物，完成后按 o；q 取消。Enter 不会确认回位。
zh.startup_home_path_clear: 检查机械臂返回 Home 的整条路径无障碍，确认后按 p；q 取消。
zh.sub_forward_hint: 子任务进行中：s 记本轮成功、f 记失败（都结束正向循环，逆向循环照常复位），d 作废本轮（复位后重做一轮）
zh.sub_inv_no: 清单被否决：运行等待人工处理
zh.sub_inv_title: VLM 列出的物体（这一份确认后就是本次运行的白名单）：
zh.sub_inv_todo: 清单对就按 y 确认，不对按 n（运行转人工等待）；q 结束运行
zh.sub_inv_yes: 清单已确认，冻结为白名单
zh.sub_release: 第 {n}/{total} 轮：确认场景就绪后按 Enter 放行本轮正向子任务循环；q 结束运行
zh.sub_reverse_hint: 逆向复位：m 请求停止自动复位并转人工（非急停）。已准入的 step 可能含多次动作，需等待安全停止；请求接受不代表可以接近。
zh.sub_reverse_ignored: 逆向循环正在复位场景：这个键在这里不起作用（停止仍然有效：Ctrl+C）
zh.sub_reverse_requested: 人工复位请求已登记：等待策略停止、记录封存及原配置允许的回位。此提示不代表可以接近机械臂；若锁定请先处理故障。
zh.sub_wait_after_forward: 停在第 {n} 轮正向循环结束之后；本轮的逆向复位没有执行：按 Enter 之前请手动恢复场景（拿不准就按 q）
zh.sub_wait_forward: 停在第 {n} 轮的正向循环中；本轮的逆向复位没有执行：按 Enter 之前请手动恢复场景（拿不准就按 q）
zh.sub_wait_idle: 这一轮还没有任何子任务动过：场景保持原样
zh.sub_wait_reverse: 停在第 {n} 轮的逆向循环中；场景只复位了一部分：按 Enter 之前请手动恢复场景（拿不准就按 q）
zh.subtask_early_shown: ── 当前正向子任务在第 {step}/{max_steps} 步暂停（{trigger}）：已停稳保存，视觉模型检查是否已完成；没完成就接着跑剩下的步数 ──
zh.subtask_end_shown: ── 当前正向子任务结束  步数 {steps}/{max_steps}；结束方式 {ended} ──
zh.sum_early_check: 提前检查：子任务运行中遇到事件（{events}）或每 {every} 步，停稳保存后让视觉模型判断是否已完成；完成就进入下一个子任务，没完成就接着跑剩下的步数（每次尝试最多 {max_checks} 次）
zh.sum_judge: 判定来源：场景核对 = {scene}；成败 = {outcome}
zh.sum_mode_human: 模式：不含复位策略（人工复位环境）
zh.sum_mode_policy: 模式：含复位策略（reset policy 复位）
zh.sum_mode_subtask: 模式：子任务循环（无复位策略：VLM 规划子任务，测评策略执行，逆向循环复位）
zh.sum_ops_human: 每轮操作：复位环境后按 [Enter]，再按 y/n/u 回答场景题
zh.sum_ops_subtask: 每轮操作：确认物体清单（只在开始时一次），每轮按 Enter 放行；正向循环中 s/f/d 给本轮下判定
zh.sum_outcome_auto: 事件智能/视觉模型自动判定（可提前结束，模式 {mode}）
zh.sum_outcome_budget: 不提前结束（跑满步数），成败由标签/事后判定
zh.sum_pose: 起始位姿检查：确认后由预检执行；未通过时进入等待并说明原因（本屏无结果）
zh.sum_rounds: 轮次：{episodes} 轮；每轮 forward 最多 {max_steps} 步
zh.sum_rounds_subtask: 轮次：{episodes} 轮；每个正向或反向子任务最多 {max_steps} 步
zh.sum_scene_operator: 操作员在本终端按键（页面也可答）
zh.sum_scene_provider: 机器 provider 先判断（仅供参考），每轮由操作员在本终端键入 y/n/u 放行
zh.sum_stop: 随时停止：Ctrl+C，或在提示处按 q
zh.svc_gpu: {n}/{total} 空闲显存 {free} MiB，需要 {need} MiB（策略 {policy} + VLM {vlm}）
zh.svc_inventory: {n}/{total} 物体清单：按 y 确认、n 否决 / 停止：q 或 Ctrl+C
zh.svc_leftover_stopped: {n}/{total} 上次运行留下的本方单元 {unit} 已核对身份并停止
zh.svc_not_released: {n}/{total} 没能确认释放：已停止 {stopped}；仍在 GPU 上的本方 pid {left}；显存 {used} MiB（开始前 {baseline} MiB）。请人工核对
zh.svc_not_stopped: 单元 {unit} 没有停止（{why}）：身份对不上时不停止，请人工处理
zh.svc_policy_ready: {n}/{total} 策略服务就绪，显存合计 {used} MiB
zh.svc_port_held: {n}/{total} 端口 {port} 已被占用且不是本次运行的单元：不启动，也不停止它。请先停止实时服务（levi live stop）再重来
zh.svc_preflight: {n}/{total} 预检：GPU 锁、显存、内存、端口 / 无需操作 / 停止：Ctrl+C
zh.svc_released: {n}/{total} 已停止 {stopped}；本方进程已离开 GPU（显存 {used} MiB，开始前 {baseline} MiB）
zh.svc_rounds: {n}/{total} 各轮：每轮按 Enter 放行 / 停止：Ctrl+C
zh.svc_shutdown: {n}/{total} 收尾：停止 VLM、停止策略、核对显存释放 / 等待
zh.svc_stopped: 已停止的本方单元：{units}；其他进程一概未动
zh.svc_vlm_ready: {n}/{total} VLM 就绪：单元 {unit}，pid {pid}，显存 {mib} MiB
zh.svc_vlm_sleep: {n}/{total} 让 VLM 睡眠（先查 MemAvailable）/ 等待 / 停止：Ctrl+C
zh.svc_vlm_start: {n}/{total} 启动 VLM 服务（本方单元），等待就绪，首次可能要几分钟 / 等待 / 停止：Ctrl+C
zh.swap_unclean_head: 之前的策略切换没有干净结束，不假定其服务状态。确认前请逐个检查服务单元（systemctl --user status <unit>）、策略端口（ss -ltnp）、nvidia-smi，并确认机械臂在回位姿态：
zh.todo_camera_stale_resume: 请检查两路相机（USB 连接、画面在更新），按 setup.md 手动回 Home，然后按 [Enter]，再按 y 确认（q 结束）
zh.todo_check_resume: 请先排除故障、确认健康监控为绿，再按 [Enter] 续跑（q 结束）
zh.todo_home_pose_resume: 请按 setup.md 手动回 Home（夹爪张开），然后按 [Enter]，再按 y 确认；续跑前会再检查一次（q 结束）
zh.todo_home_resume: 续跑前会自动检查是否在 Home；不在则不续跑。请先按 setup.md 手动回 Home，然后按 [Enter]，再按 y 确认（q 结束）
zh.todo_judge_resume: 请检查判定服务，再按 [Enter] 续跑（随后需按 y 确认；q 结束）
zh.todo_other_resume: 请处理后按 [Enter] 续跑（q 结束）
zh.todo_policy_resume: 请确认策略服务在线，再按 [Enter] 续跑（随后需按 y 确认；q 结束）
zh.todo_reset_enter: 请复位环境，完成后按 [Enter]（q 结束）
zh.todo_reset_resume: 请复位环境，完成后按 [Enter] 续跑（q 结束）
zh.todo_startup_new_run: 结束本次运行，现场检查并人工处理；之后创建新运行重新确认。不会自动清锁或归位
zh.todo_stop_resume: 确认后按 [Enter] 续跑（随后需按 y 确认），或按 q 结束
zh.todo_subtask_inventory: 检查相机和桌面后按 [Enter]：VLM 重新列物体清单（q 结束）
zh.todo_subtask_release: 按 [Enter] 后会再问一次是否放行（q 结束）
zh.todo_subtask_replan: 检查场景和 VLM 后按 [Enter]：重新放行一轮并重新规划（q 结束）
zh.todo_subtask_restart: 把场景摆回一轮开始时的样子，再按 [Enter]：这一轮从头开始（q 结束）
zh.todo_subtask_restart_confirm: 把场景摆回一轮开始时的样子，再按 [Enter]，随后按 y 确认：这一轮从头开始（q 结束）
zh.todo_vlm_resume: 释放显存或内存、检查 VLM 服务后按 [Enter]，随后按 y 确认（q 结束）
zh.verdict_hint: 本轮进行中：按 s 记成功、f 记失败、d 作废，提前结束本轮（其他键无效）
zh.verdict_taken: 已收到人工判定：{verdict}；本轮提前结束，回位后继续下一轮
zh.wait_camera_stale: 相机画面停了（帧序号多步不变或帧太旧，见下方 camera_stale）：本片段已结束，没有再发动作，机械臂停在原处，没有回 Home
zh.wait_home_not_executed: Home 在发出首条命令前被拒：机械臂没有回 Home，仍停在上一片段结束的位置
zh.wait_home_pose_not_reached: 机械臂不在 Home 位姿（误差见下方 start_pose_checked），未续跑
zh.wait_preflight_failed: 预检失败（健康监控或机器人状态）
zh.wait_reset_horizon_exhausted: reset 策略跑满步数仍未复位
zh.wait_scene_unknown: 无法判断场景（看不清/证据不足）
zh.wait_startup_home_not_executed: 首轮回位未发送动作，本次运行保留闭门且不可重试回位或续跑
zh.wait_subtask_check_unavailable: VLM 判断不了 {loop} 子任务 #{index} 是否完成（null、看不清或没有回答）
zh.wait_subtask_not_released: 本轮没有在终端 D 放行
zh.wait_subtask_plan_refused: VLM 的 {loop} 计划被拒（{reason}），没有任何动作
zh.wait_subtask_retry_limit: {loop} 子任务 #{index} 判定未完成已达 {attempt} 次（重发上限 {limit}）
zh.wait_vlm_sleep_refused: VLM 没有睡眠（{reason}；MemAvailable {mem} GiB，需要 {need}），策略没有启动
zh.wait_vlm_unavailable: 无法安全地唤醒或让 VLM 睡眠，没有任何动作
zh.wait_vlm_wake_failed: VLM 没有醒来（{reason}），没有任何动作
zh.wait_vlm_wake_refused: VLM 没有唤醒：空闲显存 {free} MiB < 阈值 {threshold} MiB，没有任何动作
